== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A [[Striker]] [[binding]] is a crystallized [[technique]] that serves as the essential core of any [[construct]]. While [[scripts]] act as drawings, [[binding|bindings]] are described as being more substantial, akin to statues or pearls, providing the heart and soul of a [[construct]]'s functionality. Without a [[binding]], a [[construct]] is merely an object with the properties of its material and any added [[scripts]]. These [[binding|bindings]] are often made from arcane materials or [[Remnants]], appearing in various forms such as spiraling drills, corkscrews, or even organic shapes resembling stars or hearts. A [[Striker]] [[binding]] is primarily used to execute [[Striker techniques]], which are offensive maneuvers designed to attack. These techniques can manifest as beams of light, projectiles like fireballs or meteors, or even physical phenomena like [[wind]] bursts and lightning. The specific effect of a [[binding]] can change based on how the user cycles their [[madra]] through it; for instance, different circulation patterns can produce different techniques from a single [[binding]]. While some [[binding|bindings]] are simple and elongated with clear inputs and outputs, others can be highly complex, featuring multiple apertures or even organically fusing several techniques into one. In advanced applications, [[Soulsmiths]] may link multiple [[binding|bindings]] together within a single [[construct]] to create powerful [[launcher construct|launcher]] devices. While such complex setups can produce devastating effects that exceed the strength of individual [[binding|bindings]], they are difficult to create, spiritually conspicuous to enemies, and place significant physical strain on the [[construct]]'s vessel. Bindings can also be integrated into limbs or weapons to allow for the venting of power, the draining of an opponent's [[madra]], or the enhancement of a user's specific [[Path]].}}
